successCriteria.description: The policy module barrel (src/modules/policy/index.ts) re-exports CreateLeavePolicyInput and UpdateLeavePolicyInput so both are importable from the barrel entry point 'src/modules/policy' (not from the internal policy.repository.ts).
A downstream module can import CreateLeavePolicyInput and UpdateLeavePolicyInput from 'src/modules/policy' (the barrel) and the project typechecks under tsc --noEmit with no missing-export errors.
The existing barrel re-exports (LeavePolicy, IPolicyRepository, PolicyRepository) remain intact and importable from 'src/modules/policy' after the change — no existing export is removed or renamed.

constraints: Only src/modules/policy/index.ts may be modified. No other source file, test file, or config may be changed.
The re-exported DTOs must originate from ./policy.repository (the file that already defines and exports them); the barrel must not re-declare or duplicate the interface definitions.

Per AGENTS.md Architecture rule #1, downstream modules must import policy types only through the barrel (src/modules/policy/index.ts), never from internal files like policy.repository.ts. The barrel must therefore expose every public type used on the IPolicyRepository interface.
outOfScope: Re-exporting CreateEmployeeInput/UpdateEmployeeInput from the employee barrel (src/modules/employee/index.ts) — the same latent gap exists there but is a separate module and not part of this phase.
Adding any new types, methods, or fields to the policy module — only the barrel re-export wiring changes.
Modifying downstream consumers (balance, leave modules) to consume the DTOs through the barrel — no downstream imports exist yet; this phase only closes the latent gap at the barrel.

entityInvariants.invariant: The interface shape defined in policy.repository.ts is the single source of truth; the barrel re-exports that exact definition without altering, narrowing, or widening it.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Policy module barrel re-export surface — must expose CreateLeavePolicyInput and UpdateLeavePolicyInput alongside the already-exported LeavePolicy, IPolicyRepository, and PolicyRepository, all sourced from their defining internal files.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: If a re-exported symbol does not exist in its source file, tsc --noEmit must fail with a missing-export error; the barrel must not silently swallow or alias away the absence.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The barrel re-export of CreateLeavePolicyInput and UpdateLeavePolicyInput must reference the exact exported interface names and source module (./policy.repository) that already define them — matching the existing pattern used for IPolicyRepository and PolicyRepository in the same barrel.

The barrel re-export style must remain consistent with the sibling employee barrel (src/modules/employee/index.ts), which re-exports the model and repository symbols from their internal files — no new export mechanism or convention is introduced.

integrationPoints.why: Downstream modules balance and leave depend on src/modules/policy/ per the reconciled architecture dependency map; the barrel is their only permitted import surface (AGENTS.md rule #1), so the DTOs used on IPolicyRepository.create/update must be reachable through it.
